- [Can you use glutathione cream with retinol?](https://www.fairnpink.in/journal/glutathione-cream-with-retinol/): Yes, glutathione cream and retinol can share one routine: use retinol at night (start twice a week) and the glutathione cream in the morning under sunscreen or on non-retinol nights. Skip retinol if pregnant or breastfeeding.
- [When to apply face cream after a facial, threading or waxing](https://www.fairnpink.in/journal/face-cream-after-facial-threading-waxing/): Wait about 24 hours after threading or waxing, until the next night after a facial, and 2 to 3 days after bleach before using an active or fragranced face cream. Until then use cool water, a plain moisturiser and sunscreen.
- [Can you use alpha arbutin and vitamin C together?](https://www.fairnpink.in/journal/alpha-arbutin-and-vitamin-c/): Yes, alpha arbutin and vitamin C can be used together: a vitamin C serum in the morning under sunscreen and an alpha arbutin cream after it or at night. Layer thinnest first, patch test, and judge dark spots after eight weeks or more.

It helps skin look more even; it does not change natural skin colour.
- [Glutathione cream for men: a simple routine for shaving, sweat and sun](https://www.fairnpink.in/journal/glutathione-cream-for-men/): Yes, men can use glutathione cream. Apply a pea-sized amount after shaving has settled (or at night), use a thin layer on oily skin, and wear sunscreen every morning. It helps skin look brighter and tan look lighter over weeks; it does not change natural skin colour.
- [Glutathione cream in winter: how to use it without dry, tight skin](https://www.fairnpink.in/journal/glutathione-cream-in-winter/): Yes, keep using glutathione cream in winter: apply it on slightly damp skin after a lukewarm wash, add a plain moisturiser on top at night if skin feels tight, and wear sunscreen every morning. Pause for a few nights if it stings.
- [Glutathione cream for pimple marks: what helps, what does not, and how long it takes](https://www.fairnpink.in/journal/glutathione-cream-for-pimple-marks/): A cream with glutathione, niacinamide and alpha arbutin can help flat dark pimple marks look lighter over 8 to 12 weeks or more with daily sunscreen. It does not help pitted or raised scars and is not an acne treatment; see a dermatologist for those.
- [Glutathione cream for sensitive skin: how to patch test, start slowly and spot a reaction](https://www.fairnpink.in/journal/glutathione-cream-for-sensitive-skin/): Many people with sensitive skin can use a glutathione cream: patch test for 2 to 3 days, start every other night, keep the routine simple and wear sunscreen. Stop if redness, itching or burning lasts. Avoid fragranced creams if fragrance bothers you.
- [Glutathione cream for oily skin: how to use it without a greasy, shiny face](https://www.fairnpink.in/journal/glutathione-cream-for-oily-skin/): Yes, oily skin can use glutathione cream: apply a very thin layer (about half a pea) on a freshly washed face, mostly at night, and keep mornings to a light layer or just sunscreen. Use less product rather than skipping moisture.
- [Glutathione and niacinamide together: can you use them, and how?](https://www.fairnpink.in/journal/glutathione-and-niacinamide-together/): Yes, glutathione and niacinamide can be used together, and many creams contain both. Apply on clean skin, thinnest product first, once or twice a day, and wear sunscreen every morning. You do not need a separate niacinamide serum if your cream already has it.
- [Can you use glutathione cream with salicylic acid?](https://www.fairnpink.in/journal/glutathione-cream-with-salicylic-acid/): Yes, glutathione cream and salicylic acid can share one routine: use a salicylic face wash before the cream, or a leave-on salicylic serum on 2 to 3 nights a week with the cream on other nights. Wear sunscreen daily and cut back if skin stings.
- [Can you apply glutathione cream before makeup?](https://www.fairnpink.in/journal/glutathione-cream-before-makeup/): Yes, glutathione cream can go under makeup: apply a thin layer on clean skin, wait 3 to 5 minutes, then sunscreen, then primer and foundation. Use less cream on oily skin to avoid pilling and shine, and remove makeup before your night routine.
- [Can glutathione cream help dark circles under the eyes?](https://www.fairnpink.in/journal/glutathione-cream-for-dark-circles/): A glutathione cream may help brown, pigmented dark circles look a little lighter over 8 to 12 weeks with daily sunscreen, using a rice-grain amount on the under-eye bone. It does not change hollows, shadows, puffiness or blue-purple circles.
- [Glutathione cream for dark neck: what helps, what does not](https://www.fairnpink.in/journal/glutathione-cream-for-dark-neck/): A glutathione cream can help a dark neck from sun, tan or friction look more even over 8 to 12 weeks with daily sunscreen and gentle washing. Thick, velvety dark skin in the neck folds needs a doctor first, as it can be linked to health conditions.
- [Glutathione cream for combination skin: how to use it on an oily T-zone and dry cheeks](https://www.fairnpink.in/journal/glutathione-cream-for-combination-skin/): Yes, combination skin can use glutathione cream: put a very thin layer on the oily T-zone and a little more on drier cheeks, mostly at night, with sunscreen every morning. It can help skin look brighter and more even over 8 to 12 weeks.
- [At what age can you use glutathione cream?](https://www.fairnpink.in/journal/at-what-age-can-we-use-glutathione-cream/): Adults of any age can use a cosmetic glutathione cream if their skin tolerates it. Most teenagers do not need one; from about 16, it can be used gently for a specific concern like tan, with a patch test and sunscreen. Children should not use it.
- [Glutathione cream for dry skin: how to use it without tightness or flaking](https://www.fairnpink.in/journal/glutathione-cream-for-dry-skin/): Yes, dry skin can use glutathione cream: apply a pea-sized amount on slightly damp skin after a gentle wash, add a plain moisturiser on top if skin feels tight, and wear sunscreen every morning. It can help skin look brighter and more even over 8 to 12 weeks.
- [Can you use alpha arbutin and kojic acid together?](https://www.fairnpink.in/journal/alpha-arbutin-and-kojic-acid-together/): Yes, alpha arbutin and kojic acid can be used together. Start with one, add the other on alternate nights after a few weeks, layer thinnest first once skin is comfortable, and wear sunscreen every morning. Kojic acid is the more likely of the two to irritate.
